title: Meta-LSQ: A Closed-Form Sobolev Inner Solver for Few-Shot Meta-Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24718v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gradient-based meta-learners such as model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) adapt to a new task with an inner loop of gradient descent that has to be differentiated through, and they meta-learn every network weight. Meta-LSQ instead fits each task with one regularised least-squares solve over a fixed random Fourier basis and meta-learns only three scalars, a bandwidth, a ridge and a derivative weight. Since the derivative of a sinusoid is again a sinusoid, the same solve can also take derivative observations, and the fitted model has exact closed-form derivatives of any order. On 10-shot sinusoid regression Meta-LSQ trains in 14 s and ends with a 5.5 times lower error than a first-order MAML baseline that trains 36 times longer, and a Gaussian-process control suggests that most of this gain comes from sharing one kernel across tasks. translated_title: Meta-LSQ：一种用于少样本元学习的闭式Sobolev内环求解器
translated_abstract: 基于梯度的元学习方法（如模型无关元学习MAML）通过一个需要被微分求导的内环梯度下降过程来适应新任务，并且要对每一个网络权重进行元学习。Meta-LSQ则改为在固定的随机傅里叶基上通过一次正则化最小二乘求解来拟合每个任务，并且只元学习三个标量：带宽、岭回归参数和导数权重。由于正弦函数的导数仍是正弦函数，同样的求解方法还能接收导数观测，且拟合出的模型具有任意阶的精确闭式导数。在10样本正弦回归任务上，Meta-LSQ仅需14秒训练，最终误差比训练时长长36倍的一阶MAML基线低5.5倍；高斯过程对照组实验表明，这一提升大部分来自跨任务共享同一个核函数。在DESY的ARES装置上结合模型导数进行的模拟束流调谐任务中，它的精度略高于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Meta-LSQ用固定随机傅里叶基上的一次闭式正则化最小二乘求解替代MAML的内环梯度下降，仅元学习三个标量即可获得任意阶精确导数，在少样本正弦回归上以约1/36的训练时间取得比一阶MAML低5.5倍的误差。
en_tdlr: Meta-LSQ replaces MAML's inner-loop gradient descent with a single closed-form regularized least-squares solve over a fixed random Fourier basis, meta-learning only three scalars and yielding exact closed-form derivatives of any order, achieving 5.5× lower error than a first-order MAML baseline while training 36× faster on 10-shot sinusoid regression.
